verdict.rationale: GitBook's pricing page lists "Preview deployments" as a feature (gitbook-docs-6). It also documents GitHub/GitLab Sync (gitbook-docs-4, gitbook-docs-27) and change requests (gitbook-docs-29), which together suggest PR-linked previews. However, the evidence is only a feature label: nothing documents that each pull request automatically gets a shareable preview URL before merge. Missing for 10: documentation that previews are triggered per Git PR, details on sharing and access to preview links, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
